local_evidence.title: AMD forecast sparks AI‑driven rally in US chipmaker stocks
local_evidence.snippet: AMD forecast sparks AI‑driven rally in US chipmaker stocks U.S. semiconductor stocks rose on Wednesday as Advanced Micro Devices' strong outlook boosted investor confidence about sustained demand for AI infrastructure and that a ‌shift toward CPUs would spur the next leg of spending. AMD jumped nearly 18% in premarket ‌trading and is on track to hit a record high if gains hold in market hours, while rival Intel rose 6%. Chip designer Arm Holdings soared 11%, while Qualcomm gained about 4%.
